package.name: faucon_drone
package.description:
Quadrotor drone integration for the Faucon autonomy stack.
Provides: - PX4 SITL + X500 co-simulation with the UGV in the same Gazebo world - PX4X500Adapter: translates /fmu/* (PX4) ↔ /faucon/drone/* (Faucon interface) - Gazebo bridge for camera image - Lightweight velocity-controller fallback (no PX4 required)
Faucon interface topics: /faucon/drone/odom nav_msgs/Odometry /faucon/drone/gps sensor_msgs/NavSatFix /faucon/drone/imu sensor_msgs/Imu /faucon/drone/state std_msgs/String /faucon/drone/cmd_vel geometry_msgs/Twist (input) /faucon/drone/arm std_msgs/Bool (input) /faucon/drone/camera/image sensor_msgs/Image
px4_msgs is part of this workspace — no external sourcing required.
